name: The Kinks

whyMatters.en: London band formed in 1963. Early Pye singles used Dave Davies’s sliced-speaker distortion and two-chord riffs; later Ray Davies albums focused on English observational songwriting.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦乐队，1963 年成立。早期 Pye 单曲用 Dave Davies 划破扬声器的失真与两和弦 riff；后期 Ray Davies 专辑转向英式观察式写歌。

essentialTracks.title: All Day and All of the Night

lyricQuotes: Girl, you really got me going / You got me so I don't know what I'm doing
Dirty old river, must you keep rolling / Flowing into the night

shortBio.en: Davies brothers, London, 1963–. You Really Got Me and All Day and All of the Night are the early riff singles; Waterloo Sunset and Lola mark the later songwriting period.
shortBio.zh: Davies 兄弟，伦敦，1963 年起。早期 riff 单曲以 You Really Got Me、All Day and All of the Night 为代表；后期写歌以 Waterloo Sunset、Lola 为参照。

body.en:
The Kinks formed in London in 1963. Ray Davies sang and wrote; Dave Davies played lead guitar. Early Pye singles You Really Got Me and All Day and All of the Night (both 1964) used power chords and a sliced-speaker guitar sound.

From Face to Face (1966) through The Kinks Are the Village Green Preservation Society (1968), Ray Davies wrote shorter, more observational songs about English places and characters. Waterloo Sunset (1967) and Lola (1970, RCA) are the best-known tracks from that stretch. Pete Quaife left in 1969; Mick Avory stayed into the 1980s.
body.zh:
The Kinks 于 1963 年在伦敦成立。Ray Davies 主唱并写歌，Dave Davies 弹主音吉他。早期 Pye 单曲 You Really Got Me 与 All Day and All of the Night（均 1964）使用强力和弦，以及划破扬声器后的失真吉他音色。

从 Face to Face（1966）到 The Kinks Are the Village Green Preservation Society（1968），Ray Davies 转向更短、更偏观察的英式人物与地点写作。Waterloo Sunset（1967）与 Lola（1970，RCA）是这一时期最知名的作品。Pete Quaife 于 1969 年离队；Mick Avory 留至 1980 年代。

note.en: Pye 45. Dave Davies sliced the amp speaker; two-chord power-chord riff.
note.zh: Pye 45。Dave Davies 划破音箱扬声器；两和弦强力和弦 riff。

note.en: From the Village Green period; clean arpeggios under Ray Davies’s lyric about Waterloo Bridge.
note.zh: Village Green 时期；干净琶音配合 Ray Davies 写 Waterloo Bridge 的歌词。

note.en: RCA single. Acoustic intro into electric chorus; narrative lyric.
note.zh: RCA 单曲。原声前奏接电声副歌；叙事歌词。

body.en:
You Really Got Me (1964) is built on a two-chord power-chord riff and Dave Davies’s distorted guitar. All Day and All of the Night used a similar approach the same year.

By Waterloo Sunset (1967) and Village Green Preservation Society (1968), Ray Davies’s writing centered on English places, characters, and mid-tempo chord songs rather than riff-led singles alone.
body.zh:
You Really Got Me（1964）建立在两和弦强力和弦 riff 与 Dave Davies 的失真吉他上。同年的 All Day and All of the Night 写法相近。

到 Waterloo Sunset（1967）与 Village Green Preservation Society（1968），Ray Davies 的写作转向英式地点、人物与中速和弦歌曲，不再只靠 riff 单曲。

title.zh: 经典四人组至 Quaife 离队

body.en:
The best-known early lineup was Ray Davies (vocals, rhythm), Dave Davies (lead guitar), Pete Quaife (bass), and Mick Avory (drums).

Quaife left in 1969. Avory remained through the 1970s chart singles. Later lineups changed bass and second guitar; the Davies brothers stayed until the mid-1990s.
body.zh:
最知名的早期阵容是 Ray Davies（人声、节奏吉他）、Dave Davies（主音吉他）、Pete Quaife（贝斯）与 Mick Avory（鼓）。

Quaife 于 1969 年离队。Avory 贯穿 1970 年代榜单单曲。后期贝斯与第二吉他有过轮换；Davies 兄弟留至 1990 年代中期。

body.en:
Garage and hard-rock bands have cited the distortion and power-chord method on You Really Got Me. Van Halen covered the song in 1978.

Blur and Oasis have pointed to Ray Davies’s English character writing and mid-tempo chord songs from the later 1960s albums.
body.zh:
Garage 与 hard-rock 乐队常提到 You Really Got Me 上的失真与强力和弦写法。Van Halen 于 1978 年翻唱该曲。

Blur 与 Oasis 曾提到 Ray Davies 在 1960 年代后期专辑里的英式人物写作与中速和弦歌曲。

body.en: Released on Pye in 1964. Dave Davies cut the amp speaker cone to get the distorted tone. The song uses a short two-chord riff and a simple verse/chorus shape.
body.zh: 1964 年由 Pye 发行。Dave Davies 划破音箱扬声器纸盆以获得失真音色。歌曲使用短两和弦 riff 与简单的主副歌结构。

body.en: 1967 single from the period around Something Else and Village Green. Clean guitar arpeggios under a lyric about the Thames and Waterloo Bridge.
body.zh: 1967 年单曲，出自 Something Else 与 Village Green 前后。干净吉他琶音，歌词写泰晤士河与 Waterloo Bridge。

body.en: 1970 RCA single. Acoustic guitar intro moves into an electric chorus. The lyric is a first-person narrative set in a club.
body.zh: 1970 年 RCA 单曲。原声吉他前奏进入电声副歌。歌词是第一人称叙事，场景设在俱乐部。

interviewQuotes.text: You Really Got Me was distortion as a song idea, not an effect.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Dave Davies

interviewQuotes.text: English life is enough material. You don't need mythology.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Ray Davies
